text: Indeed, he no longer alarmed her at all; she regarded him as a kind thing, but quite silly. Her feelings were as inflated spiritually as they had been an hour ago esthetically, before she lost Baedeker. The dear George, now striding towards them over the tombstones, seemed both pitiable and absurd. He approached, his face in the shadow. He said: “Miss Bartlett.” “Oh, good gracious me!” said Lucy, suddenly collapsing and again seeing the whole of life in a new perspective.
